topLevel.title: Hooks
topLevel.readOnlyNotice: This menu is read-only. To add or modify hooks, edit settings.json directly or ask Claude.

events: After a batch of tool calls resolves
After auto mode classifier denies a tool call
When the user submits a prompt
After a user-typed slash command expands into a prompt
When a new session is started
Right before Claude concludes its response
When the turn ends due to an API error
When a subagent (Agent tool call) is started
Right before a subagent (Agent tool call) concludes its response
When a permission dialog is displayed

PreToolUse: Input to command is JSON of tool call arguments.
Exit code 2 - show stderr to model and block tool call
Other exit codes - show stderr to user only but continue with tool call
PostToolUse: Input to command is JSON with fields "inputs" (tool call arguments) and "response" (tool call response).
Exit code 0 - stdout shown in transcript mode (ctrl+o)
Exit code 2 - show stderr to model immediately
Other exit code - show stderr to user only
Notification: Input to command is JSON with notification message and type.
Other exit codes - show stderr to user only
UserPromptSubmit: Input to command is JSON with original user prompt text.
Exit code 0 - stdout shown to Claude
Exit code 2 - block processing, erase original prompt, and show stderr to user only
Other exit codes - show stderr to user only
